children: Nutrition ingredients supplier's fiscal Q3 sales rose 8.6%, slightly beating analyst expectations
Company repurchased $28 mln of common stock during the quarter
Growth driven by higher sales and favorable mix across all segments
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current quarter or full year in its press release
HUMAN NUTRITION AND HEALTH - Higher sales in both nutrients and food ingredients businesses drove record segment revenue and operating earnings, partially offset by higher operating expenses
ANIMAL NUTRITION AND HEALTH - Segment sales rose on higher demand in monogastric and ruminant species markets, boosting operating earnings despite higher manufacturing input costs
SPECIALTY PRODUCTS - Higher sales in performance gases business led to segment growth, though partially offset by increased operating expenses
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the specialty chemicals peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Balchem Corporation is $215.00, about 24.1% above its October 22 closing price of $173.23
The stock recently traded at 28 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 29 three months ago
